economy: US dollar 103.75 (+0.31% today, +0.56% this week): a stronger dollar usually pushes gold down.
US 10-year yield 5.09% (-1 bp today): steady, no big push either way.
VIX (fear index) 24.2 (+3% today) · S&P 500 +0.16%: normal risk mood.

FOMC Meeting Minutes at 02:00 GMT+7: Federal Reserve. A tougher (hawkish) tone or fewer cuts → dollar up → gold down. A softer (dovish) tone → gold up. The press conference often moves gold more than the decision.
history_note: Levels like this held about half the time over 2 years of data, so this is a place to watch, not a trade on its own.
